name: B10-0522/2025 (PfE) – Rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the rule of law and human rights situation in Tunisia, particularly the case of Sonia Dahmani
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on Tunisia. It calls for the release of people held for speaking out or joining groups, naming journalist and lawyer Sonia Dahmani, in prison since May 2024. It asks Tunisia to protect independent media and journalists. It also backs Tunisia's bans since 2019 on wearing the burqa in public and on some Islamist political movements, and welcomes Tunisia's actions against illegal migration and terrorism.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its opinion and asks Tunisia to act.
- It affects people detained in Tunisia, journalists, and Tunisia's government.
- The text is sent to European Union bodies and Tunisian authorities; no further step is set.
